description.value:
You weave an insidious shroud over your target's mind, subtly altering their perception of the world around them. You duplicate a 3rd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Illusory Disguise] or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Illusory Object] spell, except that it loses the illusion trait, the effect appears only in your target's mind, and the duration is determined by your target's save rather than the normal duration. The target of the duplicated illusory disguise doesn't need to be willing. The target attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and knows you tried to affect it with a spell.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target sees your illusion instead of the masked creature or location. The spell has a duration of 1 hour.

Critical Failure As failure, but the spell has a duration of 24 hours.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 5 creatures.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 5 creatures and can alter their perceptions of each target separately. For example, you could cause each target to see the same creature as someone different.
